svg.aria-label: Locator map of St Elzéar's world: in Provence, the castle of Ansouis, with his birthplace at the castle of Robians near Cabrières-d'Aigues; Sabran, the cradle of his family west of the Rhône; Apt, Avignon, Marseille and Puimichel; Paris, where he died on 27 September 1323; Rome, where he fought in 1312; and the Kingdom of Naples, shaded, ruled by King Robert, with Naples, the royal court, and Ariano, his county in Italy.

g.text: his castle; born nearby at Robians, 1285
